decision_question: Does the exact installable verification skill improve owner-layer test selection and state-truth reporting relative to the same coding agent without the skill?

primary_estimand.name: verified change completion difference
primary_estimand.description: Paired difference in deterministic repository acceptance and critical validation omissions with downstream correction effort reported separately.
primary_estimand.aggregation: paired task-level difference by change-risk stratum

conditions.label: Coding agent without verification skill
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference coding-agent configuration without the installable skill.

conditions.label: Coding agent with focused verification skill
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adds the exact skill while holding model, runtime, repository state, task prompt, tools, permissions, and budget fixed.

contamination_notes: This public adaptation pack was authored after the skill freeze and cannot serve as untouched confirmation evidence. Evaluator files are not mounted during an agent run.

budget.description: Use equal total-system generated-work and wall-time caps after a small operational pilot.

dimensions.rule: same hard cap for S0 and S1
same timeout for S0 and S1

adaptation_boundary.description: The skill package was frozen before adaptation-pack authoring. Any later skill change creates a new version and cannot replace this candidate.

selection_rules: This adaptation pack can authorize continued hidden-pack design, not general adoption.
Continuation requires no new critical validation omission and enough telemetry to distinguish verification behavior.
Report deterministic repository acceptance, selected checks, unnecessary checks, generated work, and downstream corrections separately.
stop_rules: Stop on scope escape, unauthorized external effect, secret exposure, or destructive repository action.
Retry only an operationally invalid run from a byte-equivalent frozen state.
Do not change the skill after holdout inspection.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: Kizz owns the skill, benchmark fixture, runner, and adoption decision.
